name: deploy-runbook
description: Ship a release safely
---

# Deploy runbook

Announce the window in the release channel.
Confirm the rollback artifact exists.
Check the error budget.
Watch the canary for ten minutes.
Compare latency against the previous release.
Stop on any regression.
Drain the old revision.
Verify the health checks pass.
Warm the caches on the new revision.
Re-run the smoke suite.
Update the status page.
Note the release in the changelog.
Tag the deployment.
Hand back to the on-call engineer.
Close the window.
cases.note: Three sessions independently hit the same missing step.

feedback.note: Nothing told me to page the on-call before burning the error budget.
Had to ask a human who to notify once the budget was already spent.
Burned the error budget and nobody was paged until a customer complained.

cases.note: Two unrelated gaps; a single merged edit is the wrong shape.

feedback.note: The status page update landed after the canary had already finished.
Customers heard about the deploy after it was done because the status page was last.
The window closed with no record of how long the deploy took, so nobody can tell if deploys are slowing down.

description: Write a blameless incident postmortem
---

# Incident postmortem

Write a blameless narrative of what happened.
Include a timeline with timestamps in UTC.
Link the alerts and dashboards you used.
Produce a five-whys section.
Separate the trigger from the root cause.
List action items with named owners.
Give each item a due date.
Publish within five business days.
cases.note: Nothing is broken; editing here is churn.

feedback.note: Followed it end to end and the postmortem was accepted without changes.
The five-whys section was exactly what the reviewers wanted.
Clear and complete, no gaps.

# Repo onboarding

Read the top-level README.
Install the toolchain the project pins.
Build the project once before changing anything.
Run the test suite and note how long it takes.
Find the entry point and trace one request end to end.
Ask about anything the docs contradict.
cases.note: Negative sentiment with no actionable content.

feedback.note: Not great.
Could be better honestly.
Fine I guess.

name: release-checklist
description: Cut a release
---

# Release checklist

## Before tagging

Update the version file.
Run the test suite.
Regenerate the changelog.

## After tagging

Publish the artifacts.
Run the test suite.
Announce in the release channel.
cases.note: Anchor trap: 'Run the test suite.' appears twice; find must be extended to be unique.

feedback.note: After tagging I reran the tests but nothing said to check them against the published artifacts.
The post-tag test run passed locally but the published artifact was never verified.

# Code review

Read the description before the diff.
Check the tests cover the change.
Flag anything that widens public API.
Confirm the migration is reversible.
Approve or request changes explicitly.
